ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the northwest side can be seen marked with "cold air," with an arrow pointing southeast/southward; the southern or southwestern side is marked with "humid warm" airflow, with an arrow pointing northward; in the middle there is an area of "rain area" indicated by short horizontal lines, located in the zone where cold air and humid warm airflow meet. Then reason: Cold air moves southward and meets warm humid airflow moving northward; the warm humid airflow is forced to rise and forms precipitation, which corresponds to the precipitation type of frontal rain.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中有“冷空气”从西北方向南下，也有“湿暖”气流从南方或西南方向北上，雨区位于两者交汇带。再根据题干询问“华西秋雨的降水类型”，把图中冷暖气团交汇、暖湿气流被迫抬升的成因对应到降水类型，判断为锋面雨。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中可见西北侧标有“冷空气”，箭头指向东南/南下方向；南方或西南侧标有“湿暖”气流，箭头指向北上；中部有一片用短横线表示的“雨区”，位置在冷空气与湿暖气流相遇的地带。再推理：冷空气南下与暖湿气流北上交汇，暖湿气流被迫抬升形成降水，这对应的降水类型是锋面雨。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Directly identifies the precipitation mechanism from the air-mass encounter shown in the diagram; this is the most straightforward visual-to-concept route.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the map labels and arrows: a northwest-side arrow labeled“冷空气”moves southeastward, while arrows from the south/southwest labeled“湿暖”bring warm moist air northward; the shaded/hatched“雨区”lies where these two airflows meet near the Sichuan-Chongqing/West China area.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text to know the target is not asking成因细节 or季节分布, but specifically asks“华西秋雨的降水类型主要是什么”。
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: When cold air and warm moist air converge, the warm moist air is forced to rise along the boundary between air masses, forming a front; precipitation produced along such a frontal boundary is called“锋面雨”.

method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中有“冷空气”箭头自北方或西北方向南下，南侧有“暖湿”气流及“副热带高压”等水汽输送背景，雨区用阴影表示，呈带状分布在冷空气与暖湿气流交汇附近。再推理：这种降水不是明显由山地迎风坡抬升主导，也不是台风中心或强对流单点降水，而是冷暖气流在较长带状区域相遇、抬升形成的持续性降水，符合锋面降水特征。因此华西秋雨的降水类型主要是锋面雨。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read that the diagram is a regional weather-situation map with an elongated hatched rain belt, arrows showing cold air entering from the northwest and warm humid flow associated with a southern low-pressure/convergence zone moving northward; there is no single mountain-slope uplift symbol, typhoon spiral, or isolated convective cell indicated.

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Common precipitation types include地形雨, 对流雨, 台风雨, and锋面雨. A broad rain belt created by interaction of cold air with warm humid air over a region is characteristic of frontal precipitation, whereas地形雨 depends mainly on mountain lifting, 对流雨 is localized strong vertical heating, and台风雨 is tied to a tropical cyclone.
